key_highlights: ASX wiped out $169B over the past week as severe recession anxieties and labour market deterioration hit investor sentiment.
Australian unemployment surged to a five-year high, signalling significant cracks in the domestic economy and ending the RBA's hiking cycle.
Sharp downturn in Sydney and national property prices accelerates, severely impairing household wealth and discretionary spending.
The Australian Dollar faces sustained downward pressure against the USD amid macroeconomic headwinds and domestic monetary policy exhaustion.
Discretionary retail sector under intense structural strain, exemplified by mass layoffs at David Jones and intensifying share battles with Myer.

sectors.trend: Small-cap exploration and gold developers see selective capital-raising interest, while macro commodity demand remains clouded by global deceleration.
sectors.implications: Focus shifts to safe-haven gold producers (NST.AX, EVN.AX) and strategic critical mineral discoveries amid junior developer consolidation.

sectors.trend: Severe pressure on bank margins and credit quality as five prior rate hikes, spiking unemployment, and governance probes weigh on the majors.
sectors.implications: Downside risks for major lenders (CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX) driven by rising bad debt provisions and mortgage book deceleration.

sectors.trend: Discretionary retail faces acute distress with departmental downsizing, while structural dietary shifts from GLP-1 drugs begin impacting food sales.
sectors.implications: Defensive rotation favours non-cyclical consumer staples (COL.AX, WOW.AX) over discretionary retailers vulnerable to consumer retrenchment (MYR.AX).

sectors.trend: Residential price declines accelerating at historic paces alongside high borrowing costs, depressing residential development and transaction volumes.
sectors.implications: Heightened capitalization rate expansion and valuation write-downs for diversified REITs (MGR.AX, SGP.AX); quality industrial REITs (GMG.AX) remain resilient.

sectors.trend: Domestic wholesale gas market friction and cost blowouts in large-scale energy transition projects intensify regulatory scrutiny.
sectors.implications: Earnings volatility for domestic gas suppliers (WDS.AX, STO.AX, ORG.AX) due to potential government market interventions.

sectors.trend: Enterprise AI adoption accelerates structural corporate restructuring, hiring freezes, and workforce offshoring.
sectors.implications: ASX tech valuations face dual pressures of high interest rates and disruptive generative AI competition, favouring established software leaders (WTC.AX, XRO.AX).

key_themes: Imminent monetary policy pivot: The RBA tightening cycle is viewed as exhausted following surge in unemployment to five-year highs.
Macro stagflation and recession risk: Equity markets derating sharply following a $169B weekly sell-off.
Housing wealth shock: Rapid decline in property valuations exacerbating consumer belt-tightening and negative wealth effects.
AUD depreciation: Currency weakness boosting unhedged offshore earnings while raising imported cost inflation.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Domestic Recession Triggered by Labour Market Deterioration
risk_assessment.mitigation: Increase cash allocations and rebalance into defensive, non-cyclical dividend payers with unhedged offshore revenues.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing Market Contagion and Mortgage Defaults
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight domestic retail banks and residential property developers; hedge via index put options on ^AXJO.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Severe AUD Depreciation and Capital Flight
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hold foreign-currency denominated assets and dual-listed multinational exporters (BHP.AX, CSL.AX).

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Banking Governance Scrutiny and Compliance Costs
risk_assessment.mitigation: Limit exposure to institutions facing regulatory headwinds and underpayment liabilities.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Gold and Critical Minerals Producers
opportunities.rationale: Gold producers offer robust safe-haven demand and margin expansion as AUD weakens against the USD.
CSL provides counter-cyclical earnings and substantial USD revenue leverage insulated from Australian domestic recession.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective Exposure to Low-Cost Resource Majors
opportunities.rationale: Top-tier miners offer low-cost balance sheets, steady free cash flow, and strong currency hedge characteristics.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce Exposure to Big Four Retail Banks
defensive_moves.rationale: Spike in unemployment and rapid housing price corrections threaten loan growth and drive loan impairment provisions.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight Discretionary Retail and Department Stores
defensive_moves.rationale: High borrowing costs and falling real wages crush consumer spending, leading to severe margin erosion and restructuring.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Deploy Capital Protection on the Benchmark Index
defensive_moves.rationale: Broad market exposure vulnerable to further liquidation after wiping out $169B in market cap.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish (1–3 months). Market sentiment remains depressed by labour market contraction, housing slump, and earnings downgrades.
market_outlook.long_term: Neutral to constructive (6–12 months). Prospective RBA rate cuts and low currency valuation will eventually stabilise equity multiples and support export sectors.
key_catalysts: RBA Board policy statement and cash rate decision pivot
Quarterly Australian CPI and monthly inflation indicator releases
National unemployment and labour force participation prints
CoreLogic national dwelling value and auction clearance rate releases
watch_list: Labour Force Survey: Unemployment rate and underemployment changes
Major bank non-performing loan ratios and net interest margins
Global iron ore (62% Fe CFR China) and gold spot prices
